Q6113.reason: Common-law arson requires malice, meaning intent or reckless disregard of an obvious fire risk, and merely forgetting to turn off the stove is only negligence.

Q5966.reason: The cardiac cycle is the alternation of diastole and systole, with no separate named third phase.

Q8294.reason: Hydrogen bonds hold ice in an open crystalline lattice that is less dense than liquid water, so pressure favors melting and the solid-liquid line slopes negatively.
